description.en: Runs the full "skill unlocked" presentation: fades out the BGM, plays a jingle, shows the skill-unlock message (with the character and skill substituted into it), unlocks the skill, then restores the BGM. The general engine behind RunUnlockSkill.
Character ID whose skill is unlocked, substituted into the message.
Skill ID to unlock, substituted into the message.
BGM fade-out duration in frames before the sequence.
Number of frames to wait after the BGM fade before starting.
Jingle sound event ID to play.
Message substitution slot index for the character/skill.
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Unlock a skill with the standard presentation (as RunUnlockSkill does internally)
RunUnlockSkillEx("para_cp0008", "who0011", 30, 30, "J_08", 0, "sysmes-Skill-00001");
